cardigan-eisteddfod-1176.description: A bearded man in a hooded cloak and wool tunic plays a bowed fiddle in a stone hall with timber rafters. A harpist stands at the left edge. A fire burns at the centre with smoke, and rushes cover the floor. A man sits in an ornate carved chair, and robed medieval people watch from the right, including an older man in red on a bench. Banners hang from the rafters and a shield is on the wall. Fills the image edge to edge, no text, nothing graphic.

liszt-lisztomania-berlin.description: A dark-haired pianist in a black tailcoat at a polished grand piano, hands raised toward the keys. Around him women in early-19th-century dresses reach up with flowers and white handkerchiefs, and two women in the foreground look faint. The hall has gilded balconies, a chandelier and a crowded audience. No visible text, and the painting runs edge to edge.

jenny-lind-america-tour.description: A woman in a white full-length gown with dark hair up stands center on a wooden stage, singing with her hands lifted, before an audience of men in top hats and women in period dress. The setting is a grand hall with a chandelier overhead, a balcony draped with red, white and blue bunting, and an orchestra with violins and brass on the right. The painting is warm and painterly, with no visible text.

carnegie-hall-opens.description: A conductor in a black tailcoat, seen from behind, stands on a wooden podium with his arm raised and a baton in hand. He faces a grand gilded auditorium with arched ceilings and several tiers of boxes packed with men in black formal dress and women in long gowns. Below him an orchestra of string players, cellos and a brass section sits on stage, with a choir in dark robes behind them. The lighting is warm and golden, and the image has no visible text, frame or border.

first-promenade-concert.description: A large ornate concert hall with painted arched ceilings, chandeliers and a pipe organ on the right wall. A conductor in a black tailcoat stands on a raised platform, arm raised with a baton, in front of a seated orchestra with music stands. Potted palms and flowers line the platform. In the foreground, men in top hats, bowler hats and dark suits and women in long Victorian dresses stand and talk on the open floor, with a small fountain pool of ferns in the lower right. A balcony crowd is visible at upper left. Smoke or haze hangs in the air.

mahler-symphony-of-a-thousand.description: A large concert hall with a vaulted wooden ceiling and skylights. A conductor in a black tailcoat stands on a podium seen from behind, arms raised. In front of him is a big orchestra with strings, a harp, brass and cellos. Behind them rise tiers of a huge choir: women in white dresses and men in black tie. A pipe organ fills the gallery at the back. Audience silhouettes sit in the lower foreground. No visible text or frame.

hollywood-bowl-first-season.description: A large, dense audience of 1920s-style men and women in hats, coats and shawls sits on rows of plain wooden benches climbing a wooded hillside at dusk. Down in the hollow, a small orchestra plays on an open-sided canvas-canopied wooden stage. Oak trees and dark scrub-covered mountains rise behind. No visible text, border or frame; the painting runs edge to edge.

benny-goodman-carnegie-hall.description: An empty concert stage in a gilded, ornate theatre under a single spotlight. In the centre foreground a black clarinet stands on a stand. Around it are folding chairs with purple seats, brass instruments (trumpets, a trombone) resting on chairs, sheet music on stands with loose blank pages on the floor, a drum kit at left, a grand piano behind, and two double basses at right. No people are visible. The balconies are gold-trimmed with red drapes. No text, no frame.

marian-anderson-lincoln-memorial.description: An oil-style painting of a columned marble memorial's steps at dusk. In the foreground stands a bank of vintage microphones on tall stands with cables snaking across the steps. Folding chairs are scattered in rows on the plaza, a reflecting pool runs toward the background, and several fedora hats lie on the ground. No people are visible. A tiny mark sits in the bottom-right corner.

moondog-coronation-ball.description: A dim, painted indoor arena with overturned folding chairs, heaps of coats and shoes, and torn paper on a wooden floor. A saxophone on a stand and a microphone sit on a low stage at right. Double doors at the back hang open, one broken, toward a police car with flashing lights. No people, no frame, no readable text, nothing graphic.
